name: launch_or_place_app
title: Launch or attach app
description: Start an application or attach to an existing window, move it onto the virtual display and maximize it. Returns pid/hwnd plus any owned dialogs discovered at attach time. If the process starts but shows no window (console/launcher/silent installer), returns launched=true with window=false plus alive/exit_code and keeps the process running (on_no_window=leave) without adding it to the job; on_no_window=kill terminates it. Prefer path for a new instance; window/hwnd only when you intentionally take over a running app. Single-instance apps may fall back to adopting an existing window: check `reused` and `warnings`; an adopted window is only moved back on release, never closed. Windows 11 Notepad can restore the previous session's tabs when launched without args; pass `args` or confirm the title with snapshot before typing. Set `place=false` to keep the current bounds (input tools may then reject the window if it is not on the virtual display); set `maximize=false` to move without maximizing.

window.description: Attach by window title. Ignores new_instance.

ensure_document.description: Default true. Word: Ctrl+N. PowerPoint: Ctrl+N then the blank-presentation tile. PowerPoint/Excel report document_ready_reason; apps without modeling return document_ready=null.

hwnd.description: Attach by window handle (dialogs/owned popups of a tracked app, or any top-level window). Takes precedence over path/window/pid.

place.description: Default true: move the window onto the virtual display. false keeps the current bounds; input tools may reject a window left on another monitor.

maximize.description: Default true: maximize after moving. false moves/resizes to the virtual display without maximizing.

on_no_window.description: Default leave. What to do when a newly started process shows no window: leave it running (console/launcher/installer, not added to the job) or kill its process tree.

lifecycle.description: Default session: the process joins the kill-on-close job and is released with the session. detached: do not join the job; the process survives daemon crash/exit and release only restores its placement. Only affects newly started processes.

fit.description: Default clamp: if the placed window is larger than the virtual display, resize it to fit and report a warning. keep preserves the app size; read tools can still clip regions.
